status: PASS: independent read-only mathematical and source review of four-Boolean domains and exact scanner

mathematical_review.high_mask_indicators_are_binary: Two distinct outside vertices in one mask class of size at least three would have at least three common neighbors.
mathematical_review.pair_flag_normalization: For distinct high masks a,b, free labels are determined by their root masks. The edge and nonedge induced pair flags sum to Xa*Xb with no factor or divisor.
mathematical_review.higher_monomial_representation: A triple is (sum of ab pair flags)*Xc; a quadruple is (sum of ab pair flags)*(sum of cd pair flags). All masks are distinct, so free vertices from different factors cannot coincide.
mathematical_review.lower_triangle_entries: Each cached product entry is used once. It is a product value, not a quadratic-form expansion, so no off-diagonal factor of two is inserted.
mathematical_review.nonbinary_flags: Other two-free flags remain in the frozen cache. The selected high/high pair flags are binary; the code does not incorrectly apply this to every two-free flag.
mathematical_review.absence_orientation: For present set S, the atom is sum over T containing S of (-1)^(|T|-|S|) m_T. Subtracting each upper neighbor from a subset lacking that bit computes this upper-set Mobius transform.
mathematical_review.marginal_coverage: Every at-most-four marginal is a sum of atoms in one tested maximal-size marginal. Roots with fewer than four masks use their full smaller domain, including the constant-only case.
mathematical_review.scope: Finite atom nonnegativity is necessary. Passing it does not establish a common global distribution or graph existence.

integer_arithmetic_review.coefficient_sum_guard: Positive int64 coefficients and nnz*max(coefficient)<=INT64_MAX protect all CSR row sums before contraction.
integer_arithmetic_review.used_column_guard: Only tensor-referenced embedding columns are converted to int64; unreferenced columns are zero and cannot change any tensor product.
integer_arithmetic_review.contraction_guard: max(referenced embedding)*max(coefficient row sum)<=INT64_MAX protects every product and every nonnegative partial sum.
integer_arithmetic_review.transform_guard: Each monomial sums at most four cached values. Every transformed atom has at most 16 monomials, and a row has at most 16 atoms. The checked 1024*max(cached value) bound protects conversion, every subtraction, and atom row sums.
integer_arithmetic_review.negative_acceptance: Every saved atom is independently expanded as signed cached rows in Python integers, multiplied by exact automorphism orders, and checked against the negative scanned value before positive-gcd normalization.
integer_arithmetic_review.timeout_scope: Incomplete or failed scans retain incomplete status. No floating-point fallback, optimizer or eigensystem exists.
